notes: This portable slice covers one adapter-supplied object class and HLAbyte attribute. A joined subject registers two instances and sends three receive-order updates, including two updates to one instance. The target actively subscribes, verifies all three standard reflect callbacks, and a separate requester queries that target's joined-federate MOM counts and verifies one reliable class entry for two distinct reflected instances. It does not claim the remaining MOM statistics, empty per-transport responses, timestamped reflections, or overall conformance.

requirements.statement: A joined target actively subscribes to the adapter-supplied object class and attribute and receives discoveries and receive-order reflections for two subject-owned instances; a different joined federate issues the MOM query.
The subject registers two instances of the published adapter-supplied class before issuing updates; instance handles are distinct and discovered by the subscribed requester.
The subject sends two receive-order updates to its first object instance and one to its second; the requester observes the associated standard attribute values.
The joined target validates the receive-order reflect callback object, attribute value, reliable transportation, producing federate, tag, and absence of sent regions for each of the three updates.

The distinct requester selects the joined target using the standard HLAfederate request parameter. The standard MIM report groups, by object class, instances for which that target has received a Reflect Attribute Values invocation. The test decodes the standard variable array of fixed records with official data elements and the public object-class handle decoder, then verifies one reliable report with a positive count of two. Repeated reflection of the first instance does not make it a second instance.
